issue.title: feat: ed25519 digital signature scheme
issue.body:
closes #78

- [x] Implement `keygen`, `sign`, `verify` for ed25519 scheme
- [x] add doc + better comments
- [x] add benchmark 

Note:
1. Even though I did not want to, I have had to add a dependency([crypto-bigint](https://docs.rs/crypto-bigint/0.6.0-rc.6/crypto_bigint/index.html)) to deal with large numbers (256, 512-bit) used in the code.
2. I have also added a dev-dependency, [hex_literal](https://docs.rs/hex-literal/latest/hex_literal/), which is used for compile-time hex string to bytes conversion, which is not important but nice to have since there are a lot of such conversion throughout the repo.

comment.body:
Thanks for the review! 

> Mostly, I think my concern here is that this specific implementation moves further away from "first principles" than I'd like it to. Perhaps we can work this a bit to use more of ronk's native types we have (e.g., our SHA impl, PrimeField, and Curves). There would be a good amount of work to make that possible I'd imagine. I roughly see what it is, but it would be good to work towards this.

I agree with you completely! That was my concern as well. There are few things I would to point out.
Firstly, the issue with `PrimeField` is that it is not designed to work with large numbers, that is not just having bigint support but also having support for fast modular arithmetic using Montgomery form or Barrett reduction. (like you said, it will be cool to have our own implementation)

Secondly, the issue with ronkation's curve implementation is that Edwards curve is a different form of elliptic curve (different from the Weierstrass from that is used in ronkathon), so RFC mentions different parameters. But I think the main difference is point representation that we have used. I have had used extended homogeneous coordinates (which is the also recommended as per the RFC) because using affine coordinates was at least an order of magnitude slower. So they use different point addition formula.

Lastly, with SHA, we had SHA256 not SHA512. So I had to add a dependency. But, like you said, it will be better to implement sha512. (maybe not a lot of work, i guess)

issue.title: Special behaviour of trial subscriptions
issue.body:
Trial subscriptions are subscriptions that run for a shorter amount of time (instead of the full year) and let new members try a subscription before they commit for a year. Currently these trial subs can be emulated by using normal subs that require 0 shares.
By having an option to specify a subscription type as "trial" the following optimizations could be made:

1. Don't allow the selection of the trial sub, when changing subscription "size" but only during signup.
2. If the trial subscription is selected during signup, no other subscription can be selected. This is only relevant, when #38 gets implemented.
3. Automatic E-Mail before the end of the trial period let's the member choose if they want to continue their subscription and if yes, with what subscription type. This would also require an option to set the duration of the trial subscription type.

comment.body:
I started working on a draft for the "Continuation of trial subs" as described [here](https://github.com/juntagrico/juntagrico/issues/39#issuecomment-1416886160)
See #747
This is how it looks so far.

## Admin activates trial subscription
Like any other subscription. But a new trial subscription overview list, will help to focus on trial subs:
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3791946d-390a-496b-993c-9150d47f8c10)


## Member decides if they continue
### They decide with a click themselves
The member can at any time during the trial confirm that they will extend it and order subscriptions for after the trial. Or they can cancel the trial. cancellation date is set as usual (to today). Desired end date defaults to end of trial.

Reminder on home page:
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a752c80-7a3f-487b-9b72-4612b56280f7)

Same question is shown in subscription overview:
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/069a1c04-f652-45a7-9ba1-15a769253ad3)

- Yes: Opens a subscription order form, where the member can select how they want to continue. A "yes" is stored as: There is a (non-trial) part in the subscription that is waiting or activated after the trial was activated. 
- No: Cancels the trial subscription

### Member sent an email instead
The management list will also help the admin to do the task for the member. The process will be the same as the user would have done it.
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f864b56b-6161-4a21-bfcc-2f7d50812842)

## Admin confirms the choice

### Member said no
Admin confirms, i.e. deactivation date of the subscription part is set (can be in the future).
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/80924cf4-0941-4f77-bc7f-c882e55d19b7)

### Member said yes
Admin can deactivate trial part and activate new part through normal management list. But trial sub list will help to do it at once.
The follow up parts are shown in the list.
![grafik](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2e951fe-fa70-4602-bf6d-0ba1066bca4f)

Here 1 of 2 transitions are possible, that I think should be supported:
1. Trial ends and the next day the new subscription starts. Billing 1 trial sub + 1 part starting mid year.
2. Trial sub is replaced by new subscription, i.e. Only 1 part is billed but start date is when the trial had started. This is as if the trial did not happen and it was a regular par all along. This is feasible if the content of the trial part is the same as the follow up part.

Let me know if you think this would work for you.

issue.title: daily HA crash at 12am with HA 2024.12
issue.body:
Hey Gary - hope all is well and you are having a nice holiday. Thanks as always for the great work on this integration.

I'm still investigating this issue and I am not 100% sure it is caused by icloud3 - but it might be worth looking into. 

I am currently running 3.0.5.9 due to the issue with apple authentication.

I think HAOS 14 (so 2024.12.x) includes an updated version of python. Since updating to 2024.12 I have been experiencing an issue where my HA container crashes at 12am. It recovers/restarts but the crash is screwing with a number of my sensors that get reset at 12am. This is how I worked out I had an issue at all.

I have done a load of investigating and I have a feeling it could be related to the icloud3 integration. My clue is that I setup a test HA environment in a VM (HAOS) and have been running it in parallel with my prod system. I disabled icloud in my test environment and HA does not crash.

In my prod environment (where I am still experiencing this issue), I see in the HA log at the time it crashes the following entry.

`2024-12-11 00:00:10.446 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.websocket_api.http.connection] [140732429842848] Jago from 172.1.0.7: Client unable to keep up with pending messages. Reached 4096 pending messages. The system's load is too high or an integration is misbehaving; Last message was: b'{"type":"event","event":{"c":{"sensor.jago_iphone_info":{"+":{"lc":1733835610.4462795,"c":"01JERAFPAENT5WWBKX6QX48CMP"}}}},"id":7}'`

Happy to provide additional info as needed. Good if you could take a look when you get back.

Today I have reverted back to 2024.11.3 in prod as I want to confirm the issue is linked to 2024.12 (HAOS 14).
